propositions: Project code-review criteria are not admitted on the eval/calibration surface; _code_review_prompt_id accepts only static built-in physical ids without repository context
calibrate_criterion lacks a code-review membership branch and maps non-physical ids only through the default plan-review namespace
_code_review_prompt_id must accept repo_root as optional keyword and admit logical ids from code_review.registry.effective_criteria mapped via criterion_prompt_id with gate_key=code_review
calibrate_criterion must select the code-review arm when repo_root is not None and criterion_id is in the active code-review registry, resolving via criterion_prompt_id with gate_key=code_review
An active project code-review criterion with no eval spec must raise a located EvalError containing the logical criterion_id and original spec path
Backward compatibility requires plan-review criteria and built-in code-review ids to work unchanged with or without repo_root
